mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which is likely to boost corporate earnings and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) are increasing, the combination signals a strong labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining and Real GDP (GDPC1) is below trend, the combination signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
